_comment: Attribution obligations neither the NuGet restore graph nor the packaged node_modules folder express. Each entry is appended verbatim by Scripts/Generate-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1.

supplements.title: Electron
supplements.note: The application runs inside the Electron framework (see ElectronVersion in the .csproj). Electron bundles Chromium, Node.js and V8 together with their own third-party components; electron-builder installs their complete notices next to the executable as LICENSE.electron.txt and LICENSES.chromium.html, and those files are part of this product's attribution.

supplements.title: .NET 10 runtime, ASP.NET Core shared framework and base class libraries
supplements.note: Embedded into the application by self-contained publishing. They are part of the shipped artifact but never appear as package entries in the restore graph.
